title: Injective abelian sections on a hypercover of an arbitrary site
statement:
Let $\mathcal D$ be a small site with finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention], let $W\in\mathcal D$, and let $V_\bullet$ be a simplicial object of $\mathcal D$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] with an augmentation $V_\bullet\to W$ (a natural map to the constant simplicial object $W$). Set $N_0=W$; for $p>0$ let $N_p$ be the finite limit in $\mathcal D/W$ of the compatible proper faces of a $p$-simplex. Assume the sieve generated by $V_p\to N_p$ is covering for every $p\geq0$: there is a covering $\{N_{p,k}\to N_p\}_k$ of $\mathcal D$ each member of which factors through $V_p\to N_p$. Let $I$ be an injective abelian sheaf on $\mathcal D$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. With $d_i:V_{p+1}\to V_p$ the face maps, define $C^p(V,I)=I(V_p)$ for $p\geq0$, with differential $\delta^p=\sum_{i=0}^{p+1}(-1)^i d_i^*$. Then the restriction augmentation makes the sequence of abelian groups
$$0\longrightarrow I(W)\longrightarrow I(V_0)\xrightarrow{\delta^0} I(V_1)\xrightarrow{\delta^1}I(V_2)\longrightarrow\cdots$$
exact. In particular its degree-zero identification is induced by restriction from $W$. The topology need not be subcanonical, and the hypercover need not be split.

source.place: Tag 01GW, lemma-injective-trivial-cech; representable special case, with covering-sieve hypotheses as in Tag 01GE, lemma-acyclic-hypercover-sheaves. No subcanonicality hypothesis.
